strings.hero_title: Know what's wrong with your crop — in your own language.
strings.hero_lead: Describe the problem, upload a photo, or just speak. AgriAid gives you likely causes, treatment steps and prevention tips in seconds, and can read them aloud.
strings.title: Crop disease diagnosis
strings.supported_crops: Supported crops: tomatoes, potatoes, wheat, rice, and common vegetables
strings.describe_issue: Describe the issue in your language
strings.text_placeholder: e.g., My tomato leaves have yellow spots...
strings.drop_image: Drag & drop or click · JPG, PNG, WEBP · max 8 MB
strings.photo_tip: Tip: take a close, well-lit photo of the affected leaf.
strings.translation_unavailable: The requested language response could not be generated. Please try again.
strings.disclaimer: AI guidance only. For serious or widespread outbreaks, consult a local agronomist.
strings.step1_text: Type symptoms in any supported language, upload a photo of the leaf, or record a short voice note.
strings.step2_text: AgriAid identifies likely diseases, pests or deficiencies and estimates confidence.
strings.step3_text: Receive treatment steps and prevention tips in your language — and listen to them if reading is hard.
strings.feature_languages_text: English, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Punjabi, Bengali and Gujarati.
strings.feature_voice_text: Voice input transcribes your description, even in regional languages.
strings.feature_photo_text: Upload an image of the affected plant for a visual assessment.
strings.feature_audio_text: Hear the diagnosis and remedies read out in your language.
strings.feature_phone_text: Responsive design that works on low-end phones and desktops alike.
strings.feature_private_text: No account needed. Photos and audio are not stored by AgriAid.
strings.crop_note: Diagnoses are AI suggestions and accuracy depends on input quality. Always confirm severe cases with a local agronomist or agriculture office.
strings.footer_tagline: AI-powered crop disease diagnosis for farmers.
strings.error_photo: Please choose a JPG, PNG or WEBP image.
strings.error_audio: Please record or upload an audio file.
strings.error_mic: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in your browser or upload a file.
strings.error_recording: Recording is not supported in this browser. Please upload an audio file instead.
strings.copy_failed: Could not copy the diagnosis. Please try again.
